# Player Character

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#PlayerCharacter)*

A player character is a character controlled by a player. *See also* ["Creating a Character"](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/creating-a-character/).
